text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see... 'I'm always cheering for you!',
'You look so cool when you race!'—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you got so many.
Ryan-chan, you're as popular as ever~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Popular, huh.
It doesn't really feel real to me, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, fan letters really do make me happy.
It's like their words give me strength!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm.
Every single letter is a precious treasure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Lady Mejiro Ryan. Ever since I saw you run, my heart hasn't stopped racing for even a single day—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"It looks like a love letter!
Kyaa~, how bold~♪"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well, for someone as popular as Ryan-chan, this must be an everyday occurrence—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-An everyday occurrence...?
There's no way that's true~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
N-No... my juniors tell me
stuff like that all the time, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's more like a senior-junior bond, or rather, just friendly physical affection...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A-Anyway! It's totally not like a, l-l-l-love letter or anything...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I-I'm gonna go run for a bit!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she left...
Man, I really think everyone is serious about this, though...
Though too shy to look at them directly, every single fan letter seemed to fire up Mejiro Ryan's motivation.
